Every 3 minutes, the system claims creator rewards in SOL, converts them into wrapped Bitcoin (wBTC), and distributes the wBTC proportionally to qualifying holders.

Rewards are distributed automatically to eligible holders. No manual claiming is required.

The core idea is simple:

SOL creator rewards are the source of revenue.
Those rewards are converted into wBTC.
Holders receive exposure to Bitcoin through automatic distributions.

This is not the same as:

Holding a stablecoin like USDC, which is designed to remain near $1.
Holding a dividend token focused primarily on income.
Holding SOL directly and relying entirely on altcoin market cycles.

wBTC is directly tied to Bitcoin’s market value. If Bitcoin appreciates over time, distributed wBTC may also increase in value alongside it.

That means the system is designed around:

Automated BTC exposure
Passive distributions
Long-term alignment with Bitcoin performance

Professional wording for your stream/banner copy:

“Every 3 minutes, the bot claims creator rewards in SOL, converts them into wrapped Bitcoin (wBTC), and distributes it proportionally to eligible holders with 500,000+ $BTCBANK tokens.

Rewards are sent automatically — no claiming required.

SOL rewards in. wBTC distributed out.

The goal is simple: turn creator rewards into long-term Bitcoin exposure for holders.”
